scope: Confirmatory false-positive calibration for canonical KGW SelfHash and SynthID-Text on a balanced-by-source Dolly task mixture; not an attack result

selection.allocation: Hamilton proportional allocation over eligible remaining source rows; identical quotas in both splits

acceptance.cell_definition: 2 schemes x 10 detector keys x 3 generated-token lengths
acceptance.interval: exact one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper confidence bound
acceptance.global_gate: pass only if every one of the 60 confirmation cells has an exact upper bound <= 0.01
acceptance.synthid_threshold_policy: one shared threshold per model x length, set to the maximum of the ten key-specific calibration candidates; confirmation is still checked separately for every key
acceptance.category_analysis: diagnostic only; no category-specific threshold tuning or confirmatory claim

separation.confirmation_access: confirmation generation and evaluation begin only after threshold artifact is frozen and hashed
